name: 図書館
description: A quiet public library with wooden bookshelves full of colourful books along the back and left walls. Three reading tables each have four people sitting around them: one group is talking and pointing at an open book, one student is taking notes in a notebook, and people have open books, laptops, notebooks, pens, cups of drink, a desk lamp, and water bottles on the tables. A person reads alone in a green armchair by the window. A person stands browsing the shelves. A librarian stands behind the front counter with a stack of books and a card. A book cart with returned books, a clock and posters on the wall, plants, and a backpack hanging from one chair.
